# .github

GitHub repository metadata for `docxology/transformer`.

- [`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) — bug report, documentation, feature request, and question forms.
- [`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) — PR checklist (tests, docs, style).

No GitHub Actions workflows are defined here: the repository has no CI pipeline, so run the test
suite locally with `pytest tests/ -q` after `pip install -r requirements.txt`
(see [`../CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
